svg.title: A MAC address
svg.desc: The 6 bytes of a MAC address, e0:dc:a0:4d:2e:91: the first three are the Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI) of the manufacturer, here Siemens, the last three the NIC-specific part. Bit 0 of the first byte is the I/G bit: 0, so the address is unicast. display_with_oui() gives Siemens:4d:2e:91.
